paragraphs: iCEV sells online career and technical education curriculum, assessments, certifications, and reporting in one platform. The curriculum catalog spans 200+ digital courses across CTE pathways including Agricultural Science, Health Science, and Law, Public Safety, Corrections & Security. Certification readiness is part of the offering, with 19 industry certifications hosted on the iCEV Testing Platform and curriculum aligned to 100+ industry certifications.

Districts are the stated audience, with the homepage listing consistency across campuses, credential visibility, teacher onboarding, and program oversight as what districts gain. Miami-Dade County Public Schools appears on the homepage, with a CTE instructional supervisor quoted about the platform. The case studies page features Santa Rosa County District Schools, which the page says supports more than 9,000 CTE students across northwest Florida.

The company dates to 1984, when Gordon W. Davis founded Creative Educational Video and began producing videos on Agricultural Science. iCEV acquired Eduthings in 2023, adding automated data management and analysis tools for administrators tracking program effectiveness and funding reports.

quote.text: iCEV brings high quality curriculum, assessments, certifications, tracking and reporting together in one solution built to support teachers and drive results.
